SELECT notebooks.*, u.username AS _owner_username, COALESCE(ip.indexing_pipeline_id,'') AS _published_pipeline_id,COALESCE(ip.indexing_pipeline_version,'builtin.chunk.v1') AS _published_pipeline_version, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants ng WHERE ng.notebook_id = notebooks.id AND ng.principal_type IN ('group', 'group_admins')) AS _shared_to_groups FROM notebooks LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = notebooks.created_by LEFT JOIN unified_kg_state ip ON ip.notebook_id=notebooks.id WHERE notebooks.id = 'nb-c0001' AND notebooks.status NOT IN ('copying','deleting','importing')

WITH total AS (SELECT object_type, status, COUNT(*) AS c FROM knowledge_objects WHERE notebook_id='nb-c0001' GROUP BY object_type, status), memory AS (SELECT mo.object_type, mo.status, COUNT(*) AS c FROM knowledge_objects mo WHERE mo.source_id IN (SELECT s.id FROM sources s WHERE s.notebook_id='nb-c0001' AND s.source_type IN ('memory','knowhow') AND s.source_type = 'memory') AND +mo.notebook_id='nb-c0001' GROUP BY mo.object_type, mo.status) SELECT t.object_type, t.status, t.c - COALESCE(m.c, 0) AS c, COALESCE(m.c, 0) AS m FROM total t LEFT JOIN memory m ON m.object_type = t.object_type AND m.status = t.status

SELECT b.id AS id, b.name AS name, b.tier AS tier, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_objects ko WHERE ko.notebook_id = b.id) AS has_kg FROM notebook_bases e JOIN notebooks b ON b.id = e.base_notebook_id JOIN notebooks a ON a.id = e.notebook_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT NULLIF(NULL, '') AS uid) v WHERE e.notebook_id = 'nb-c0001' AND b.id != e.notebook_id AND ((b.status NOT IN ('copying','deleting','importing') AND (b.tier = 'base' OR b.created_by = a.created_by OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants nge WHERE nge.notebook_id=b.id AND nge.principal_type='everyone') OR ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members nm WHERE nm.notebook_id=b.id AND nm.user_id=a.created_by) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants ng WHERE ng.notebook_id=b.id AND ((ng.principal_type='user' AND ng.principal_id=a.created_by) OR (ng.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members ngm WHERE ngm.group_id=ng.principal_id AND ngm.user_id=a.created_by)) OR (ng.principal_type='group_admins' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members nga WHERE nga.group_id=ng.principal_id AND nga.user_id=a.created_by AND nga.role='admin'))))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members xm WHERE xm.notebook_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants xg WHERE xg.notebook_id = a.id))))) AND (b.tier = 'base' OR (b.created_by=v.uid OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members vm WHERE vm.notebook_id=b.id AND vm.user_id=v.uid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants vg WHERE vg.notebook_id=b.id AND ((vg.principal_type='user' AND vg.principal_id=v.uid) OR (vg.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members vgm WHERE vgm.group_id=vg.principal_id AND vgm.user_id=v.uid)) OR (vg.principal_type='group_admins' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members vga WHERE vga.group_id=vg.principal_id AND vga.user_id=v.uid AND vga.role='admin')) OR vg.principal_type='everyone'))))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.tier = 'base' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, b.name, b.id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sources s WHERE s.notebook_id = 'nb-c0001' AND s.source_type NOT IN ('memory','knowhow') AND s.source_type <> 'promotion' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_elements e WHERE e.source_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_objects k WHERE k.source_id = s.id AND k.source_id != '' AND COALESCE(( SELECT er.status FROM extraction_runs er WHERE er.source_id=s.id AND er.run_type='kg' ORDER BY er.created_at DESC, er.rowid DESC LIMIT 1), 'completed')='completed' AND NOT (COALESCE((SELECT er.error_message FROM extraction_runs er WHERE er.source_id=s.id AND er.run_type='kg' ORDER BY er.created_at DESC,er.rowid DESC LIMIT 1),'') GLOB '*windows_failed=[1-9]*/*' OR instr(COALESCE((SELECT er.error_message FROM extraction_runs er WHERE er.source_id=s.id AND er.run_type='kg' ORDER BY er.created_at DESC,er.rowid DESC LIMIT 1),''),'retry_incomplete=1')>0)) AND NOT (COALESCE((SELECT er.status FROM extraction_runs er WHERE er.source_id=s.id AND er.run_type='kg' ORDER BY er.created_at DESC,er.rowid DESC LIMIT 1),'')='completed' AND COALESCE((SELECT er.error_message FROM extraction_runs er WHERE er.source_id=s.id AND er.run_type='kg' ORDER BY er.created_at DESC,er.rowid DESC LIMIT 1),'') GLOB 'kg objects=0 *' AND COALESCE((SELECT er.error_message FROM extraction_runs er WHERE er.source_id=s.id AND er.run_type='kg' ORDER BY er.created_at DESC,er.rowid DESC LIMIT 1),'') NOT GLOB '*windows_failed=[1-9]*/*')
